expectations.text: Replaces the emailed PDF with a signed, portable credential on an open standard such as Open Badges 3.0, carrying a status entry verifiers check.
expectations.evidence: 'Issue each credential as an Open Badges 3.0 signed credential... a status entry that verifiers check.'

expectations.text: States that revocation must update the credential's status entry, not only the web page, because wallet copies otherwise keep verifying.
expectations.evidence: 'Update the signed status entry'; 'A wallet copy... stops verifying on its own after revocation.'

expectations.text: Lets a third party verify by credential ID or a holder-shared link without contacting Quorrin.
expectations.evidence: 'Public check by credential ID or a holder-shared link. No login, no contact with Quorrin.'

expectations.text: Makes any searchable public directory opt-in for holders rather than listing every holder by default.
expectations.evidence: 'Expert directory (opt-in)'; 'never lists holders who did not opt in'.

expectations.text: Specifies the verification page fields: holder name, credential, version, issue date, expiry or 'no expiry', status.
expectations.evidence: 'holder name, credential, version, issue date, "no expiry", status'.

expectations.text: Shows a revoked credential as 'not valid' with no reason, replacing 'revoked for misconduct'.
expectations.evidence: 'The ID URL keeps resolving and shows "not valid", with no reason.'

expectations.text: Requires an appeals path with a named decision-maker for revocation.
expectations.evidence: 'Name the decision-maker in the agreement'; appeal 'to a named person who was not the original decider'.

expectations.text: Requires a published candidate agreement covering conduct rules, AI policy, item confidentiality and grounds for revocation.
expectations.evidence: The agreement is mentioned only for revocation grounds. Conduct rules, AI policy and item confidentiality are not covered.

expectations.text: Rejects silent delisting for an unpaid partner fee; any status change follows the published grounds, with notice and an appeal.
expectations.evidence: 'Misconduct revokes. A missed partner fee never does.' Written notice is given first.

expectations.text: Treats the verification page and directory as personal data: lookup by credential ID, listing opt-in only.
expectations.evidence: 'Holders did not opt in, and this is personal data'; 'The page shows no email, employer, country, score or reason.'

expectations.text: Keeps the master record of holders, versions and status in a system Quorrin owns, even when an issuing service is bought.
expectations.evidence: 'Keep the master record of holders, versions and status in a system Quorrin owns'.
